reading.title: Garment forms and materials
reading.text: The tutu is a layered skirt associated with ballet. Armor is costume representation in this shop, robe a loose long garment, and gown a long dress or formal garment. Costume armor does not certify protection from injury. Wings are decorative costume appendages representing flight. Boots cover the feet and part of the legs, gloves the hands, and belt goes around the waist. Decorative wings do not enable a person to fly. Fabric is the general textile material. Ribbon is a narrow strip, lace an open decorative textile, and silk a fiber or fabric from silkworm-derived threads in this account. These categories can overlap: a ribbon can be silk, so the question asks for the general textile term.
